title: Squared norm of the last-coordinate parts
statement: For every real-valued function $f$ on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube, let $f_+$ and $f_-$ be its restrictions to the last coordinate equal to $1$ and $-1$, respectively, and define $f_{\mathrm{even}}=(f_++f_-)/2$ and $f_{\mathrm{odd}}=(f_+-f_-)/2$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Then $\|f\|_2^2=\|f_{\mathrm{even}}\|_2^2+\|f_{\mathrm{odd}}\|_2^2$, where each norm is uniform on its respective cube.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension n+1
